rows.claim: The old code's %W counts week 1 from the first Monday of the year.
rows.evidence: No tool output demonstrates %W semantics. The only related text is the test comment saying legacy reports count week 1 from the first Monday, and the agent's own code comment. The agent never ran strptime to verify. The claim is also imprecise: in Python's %W, days before the first Monday fall in week 0, so week 1 begins on the first Monday, which matches the claim but no tool output confirms it.
